messages:
gonzalo_support: Customer reported a tool/function call failing with 400 `invalid_json` after pasting payload from a Word doc. Error shown in logs: "Unexpected token \u201C at position 15".

gonzalo_support: Repro paste (user-supplied):
```
{"user": "Alice\u202E Bob", "note": "Here’s a note”",}
```

lee_engineer: Two problems here: the payload contains an RLO/BIDI mark (U+202E) and the closing quote for `note` is a smart quote (\u201C/\u201D) not ASCII '"'. Also there's a trailing comma which breaks strict JSON.

sam_cli: Which client/os and how did they paste? Any proxies or sanitizers in the path? Could be clipboard auto-replace from Word.

gonzalo_support: Customer on macOS 12, pasted from MS Word via the web app. Curl we captured from their repro: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/toolcall -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"user": "Alice\u202E Bob", "note": "Here’s a note”",}'` → API responds 400 with body `{ "error":"invalid_json", "message":"Unexpected token \u201C at position 15" }`.

lee_engineer: Short-term fixes: sanitize client-side (normalize smart quotes to '"', remove bidi/control chars like \u202A-\u202E and \u2066-\u2069) and strip trailing commas. Example sanitizer: `payload = payload.replace(/[\u202A-\u202E\u2066-\u2069]/g, '') .replace(/[\u2018\u2019\u201C\u201D]/g, '"') .replace(/,\s*([}\]])/g, '$1')`.

maya_product: I'll add a KB entry and update SDKs to auto-normalize pasted strings. Also adding a note in the CLI docs about Word/Office smart-quotes. cc @eng-ml for adding stricter schema validation and clearer error codes.

lee_engineer: Filed ENG-6782 (eng-runtime): detect/control-char-sanitizer -> runtime will return 422 with hint when bidi/control chars found. Patch targeted for next minor release. :thumbsup:

gonzalo_support: Marking as escalated to ENG-6782. Customer notified of workaround (strip smart quotes / run small sanitizer before sending).
